import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.313208411451037
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*v**2 + p[3]*v**3 + p[4]/v + p[5]*x/v
    h = (p[6] + p[7]*v)*np.cos(w*t) + (p[8] + p[9]*v)*np.sin(w*t)
    return base + h
